concepts.title: Fracture Nexus — Hero Overview
concepts.design_question: What does the entire game mean by dimensions?
concepts.prompt:
Create a Roblox-native environment concept for GRAB THE WEIRD. It must look buildable inside Roblox Studio: blocky Roblox-scale figures, chunky simplified geometry, toy-like polished materials, clean silhouettes, readable colors, clear floors and restrained lighting. Use the supplied reference only for proportion, palette, readable silhouettes and cyan Rift language; do not reproduce their characters, branding text or exact composition. No photorealism, Unreal Engine realism, Pixar or Fortnite anatomy, generic fantasy filigree, surface micro-detail, excessive bloom, arbitrary neon or purposeless floating debris. Every impossible feature must explain a gameplay rule. No captions, UI, logos or watermarks. Show actual level-design logic rather than atmosphere alone. Violet and magenta are confined to dimensional fracture seams; cyan remains the clearest stable-travel cue. Compose one coherent environment view, not a collage or promotional board; only the artifact study uses an object sheet.

PRIMARY DESIGN SUBJECT: A fractured research crossing around one central Dimensional Core. Giant's Kitchen counters form the warm left cluster; a broken Moon Aquarium dome forms the cool right cluster; chunky Toybox rails form the upper cluster; an upside-down city is a distant silhouette. Each cluster connects to the Core by a visible broad bridge.
GAMEPLAY READ: Three blocky players carry one large golden refrigerator together toward a visible cyan return gate. Show an optional side loop without hiding the safe route.
DIMENSIONAL RULE: Each fragment retains its own local gravity, but all usable bridge decks share a stable orientation. Orbiting architecture is a distant landmark outside the carry path.
LANDMARK: One faceted split Core supported above the central platform, visible from every approach.
TRAVERSAL: Clear ground-level cargo route, broad straight bridges, generous turning pads, a short ramp and portal windows framing possible future dimensions.
PLAYER SCALE: Recognizable blocky Roblox figures, consistent limb proportions and solid foot contact; no exact character cloning.
ARTIFACT: One chunky golden refrigerator with a single cyan eye; legible against the neutral floor.
COLOR LANGUAGE: Ink-blue Core framing; cream/wood/coral Kitchen; deep navy/pale aqua Aquarium; muted primary Toybox colors; gold artifacts and cyan travel only.
CAMERA: Wide elevated 24mm view that exposes all bridges, arrival and return route; keep the distant city subordinate.

PRIMARY DESIGN SUBJECT: An oversized kitchen counter enters a cracked orbital Aquarium wall. A single spherical volume of water hangs across the ceiling; the top half of a chunky refrigerator intersects the water while its base stays on the floor. Stars are visible through one bounded wall opening.
GAMEPLAY READ: Three blocky players steer a large Moon-in-a-Jar along a dry lower route. One player investigates a raised side catwalk.
DIMENSIONAL RULE: Suspended water changes gravity for loose utensils above the catwalk; the dry cargo route stays stable. A utensil's motion follows this one visible volume rather than random levitation.
LANDMARK: Half-submerged refrigerator and one large water sphere share the crossover seam.
TRAVERSAL: A broad dry route curves around the sphere's support, with turning space, a gentle ramp and a raised optional catwalk. Both exits are visible.
PLAYER SCALE: Recognizable blocky Roblox figures, consistent limb proportions and solid foot contact; no exact character cloning.
ARTIFACT: A chunky transparent jar with a solid small moon and a simple gold handle.
COLOR LANGUAGE: Cream/coral kitchen surfaces transition to navy/pale aqua through one clean seam; cyan remains reserved for gates.
CAMERA: Wide 24mm corner view exposing entry, both route heights and the exit; show the water boundary clearly.

PRIMARY DESIGN SUBJECT: A Kitchen/Aquarium crossover collapses behind three blocky players carrying one bulky artifact. One emergency extraction gate is ahead, framed by solid dark supports. A bounded water anomaly moves beside the failing secondary route.
GAMEPLAY READ: Players retreat together along a broad visible path to the emergency gate. One losing route is clearly behind them, with another continuous route still available.
DIMENSIONAL RULE: Collapse progresses from the rear toward the gate; an alternate return deck stays intact long enough for cargo. Water drift is side pressure, not random full-screen chaos.
LANDMARK: The emergency cyan gate, visible through the entire foreground route.
TRAVERSAL: Continuous cargo-width floor and turning landing, one collapsing branch in the background, a readable surviving bypass. Show the end of the path.
PLAYER SCALE: Recognizable blocky Roblox figures, consistent limb proportions and solid foot contact; no exact character cloning.
ARTIFACT: One oversized gold refrigerator held by the group; do not obscure their feet or the gate.
COLOR LANGUAGE: Warm cream/wood foreground; dark navy collapsing background; local amber warnings; cyan return gate remains the clearest focal point.
CAMERA: Wide 24mm side-rear view exposing feet, cargo, bypass and gate; frozen final 20–40-second design keyframe.

PRIMARY DESIGN SUBJECT: A clean seven-object concept sheet: Clockwork Jellyfish, Moon in a Jar, Bottomless Frozen Cup, Orbiting Golden Fridge, Runaway Door, Small Sun, Reverse Fishbowl. Each is a chunky Roblox-buildable assembly with no tiny filigree.
GAMEPLAY READ: Use three small blocky Roblox figures as a shared scale key along the bottom, without making this a character poster. Objects must look graspable or cooperative to carry.
DIMENSIONAL RULE: Each object's silhouette implies one behavior: jellyfish pulses, jar contains a moon, cup has impossible depth, fridge has a bounded orbit, door moves away, sun glows locally, fishbowl reverses inside and outside.
LANDMARK: Seven distinctly different silhouette families with three to five large visible pieces each.
TRAVERSAL: Use front three-quarter object views with clear bounding boxes and uncluttered negative space; show no environment or cosmetic levitation unrelated to the behavior.
PLAYER SCALE: Recognizable blocky Roblox figures, consistent limb proportions and solid foot contact; no exact character cloning.
ARTIFACT: All seven named objects; do not add duplicates or an eighth item.
COLOR LANGUAGE: Limited cream/ink/steel bases; restrained dimension color; gold fridge and sun; aqua only for water-like contents and cyan eye.
CAMERA: Orthographic-like wide artifact sheet, 4:3 aspect ratio; no perspective trick that hides contact points.
